fieldValues.title: Pin bumps are automatable PRs
fieldValues.decision_question: Which merge gate does a PR take when it only bumps a pin?
fieldValues.context:
Problem: pin bumps have been owner merges. The two group charters escalate 'a pin bump in another repo' (boundary on roles 834b61fd and 1fc9ce85), and central-group pin bumps were labelled gate:owner-merge. Yet a pin only deploys code that was already reviewed and merged at its source. srs-programme#173, which deploys the upkeep from clerk#90, waited on the owner after the owner had already merged clerk#90 and a dry run had passed.
Why it matters: owner reviews of pin bumps re-judge work already judged, adding to the decision load the programme is trying to cut (SP-63, suggested).
Options and consequences: (a) a pin-only PR is gate:auto-merge; (b) the same, but only with a green dry run or CI evidence of the new version; (c) do nothing.
Recommendation: (a), as the owner instructed (2026-10-20).
Action needed: ratify in a session; on ratification, remove 'a pin bump in another repo' from both group charters' boundary, and from routines/wg-builder.md and wg-reviewer.md.
Urgency: low. The owner's instruction already applies to central-group PRs (srs-programme#173 relabelled).
fieldValues.friction: srs-programme#173 deployed code the owner had already merged, and still queued for the owner.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
(a) A PR whose diff only changes pinned versions, tags or commit SHAs of something already merged or released at its source is gate:auto-merge, and merges when clean like any other. A pin bump that also changes code is classed by that code. Leads to deploys landing without a second owner review; the review happened at the source. Leans to throughput on 'Human judgement and agent throughput'.
(b) The same, but auto-merge only with a green dry run or CI run that exercises the new version. Leads to one more gate, which most pins already get from CI.
(c) Do nothing: pin bumps stay owner merges, and groups keep escalating them. Leads to the owner re-reviewing work already reviewed at its source.
fieldValues.key_requirements: The pinned target must already be merged on its source's default branch or published as a release. The PR's diff must change nothing but pin values. CI must be green.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A PR that only bumps a pin to something already merged or released at its source is gate:auto-merge, for the central group and for every working group.
fieldValues.rationale: Review belongs at the source, where the code changes. A pin only chooses when reviewed code is deployed.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a pin bump that merged automatically breaks a consumer and the source review could not have caught it.
